name: getSOAPResponseHeader
description:
Returns a SOAP response header. Call this function
from within code that is invoking a web service after
making a web service request.
syntax: getSOAPResponseHeader( any webservice, string namespace, string name, [boolean asXML] )

params.name: webservice
params.description: A webservice object as returned from the cfobject tag or the CreateObject function.

params.name: namespace
params.description: A String that is the namespace for the header.

params.name: name
params.description: A String that is the name of the SOAP header.

params.name: asXML
params.description:
If True, the header is returned as a XML object;
if false (default), the header is returned as a Java object.
